ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'Dhi Quwwah' and 'Makin' in Surah At-Takwir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) or specifically to Imam Ali (peace be upon him), highlighting his unique spiritual authority and closeness to the Divine. The term 'Makin' (firmly established) underscores his stable and elevated position in the celestial hierarchy, serving as a testament to his role as the perfect human (Insan al-Kamil) who bridges the earthly and divine realms.
